_comment: Grandpa acknowledges the actual current party after this character returns with the Home Key following Stormwood. Names, starter status, earned bond counters and recorded personal choices are substituted from live personal state.

regional_homecoming_0.speaker: Grandpa Elias
lines: You're home. Word reached us that the Dynamo has fallen quiet.
From the Meadows through Tidewake and Cloudreach to Stormwood, you found your own way.
Come sit a minute. I'm glad you're here.
